entries.printed: Surprised characters skip their first turn entirely and cannot defend on it.
When you know you are being attacked, you may attempt one active defense (unless you took an All-Out Attack maneuver).

Dodging ranged attacks: You may Dodge normally. If you did not know the shot was coming (no visible wind-up, fired from concealment), you cannot defend at all — the bullet arrives before you can react. This is why Danger Sense and Spiritual Intuition are valuable.
Being Pinned: A pinned victim cannot attack, defend, or move, but may still shout, use mental or no-gesture SPI abilities, and attempt an Escape on their turn.
